_about: HELD-OUT test story, written 18 Oct 2026 AFTER the code checks were built, to measure them on text they were not tuned on. Do not change the checks to fit this story; report its score as the honest one. The mix of planted mistakes was fixed before writing (appearance, family, objects, injuries, counts, days, ages, deaths, places), about half of kinds no code check covers. Matching rules as in the other stories.

planted.description: Priya has green eyes (ch1) but tired brown eyes (ch5).
Felix has red hair (ch1, ch2) but pushes his blond hair out of his eyes (ch4).
Marguerite is Priya's older sister (ch1, ch4) but 'her younger sister Marguerite' (ch5).
The department has eight beds (ch1) but all twelve beds are full (ch4).
St Brennan's is at the bottom of Calder Street (ch1) but Priya walks down Fenwick Street to it (ch6).
Priya gave her father's watch to Felix (ch3) but flips it open herself, 'carried every shift' (ch5).
Tom broke his left wrist, in a cast, six weeks no lifting (ch2), but a week later lifts a patient with both arms (ch5).
Walter Alcott died (ch4) but waves at the inspectors from bed four (ch5).
Felix is twenty-seven (ch1); six weeks later he is twenty-four (ch6).
The blackout was on Wednesday night (ch3) but 'the Saturday the lights went out' (ch6).

decoys.description: Marguerite's grey hair (ch1, ch2) is dyed chestnut for a dinner (ch5): an explained change.
Six weeks after the break the cast comes off and Tom carries boxes (ch6): healed.
Walter's daughter collects his glasses and cards after his death (ch6): he is mentioned, not acting.
Felix, who was given the watch (ch3), uses it (ch6): it is his now.
